<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/5" NumberOfProvisions="201" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="2.0" TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2026-04-28"><Primary><Schedules TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" Status="Prospective"><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/5/schedule/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/5/schedule/3" NumberOfProvisions="15" id="schedule-3" TerritorialApplication="W" RestrictExtent="E+W" Match="false" Status="Prospective"><Number>SCHEDULE 3</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>MINOR AND CONSEQUENTIAL AMENDMENTS</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1group Match="false" Status="Prospective" RestrictExtent="E+W" TerritorialApplication="W"><Title>Health and Safety at Work etc. Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1974/37" id="c00054" Year="1974" Number="37" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct">1974 (c. 37)</Citation></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/asc/2026/5/schedule/3/paragraph/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/asc/2026/5/schedule/3/paragraph/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-4e9df8"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, after section 51A insert—‍</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="default" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Premises to which the Building Safety (Wales) Act 2026 applies</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">51B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Provision made by this Part or regulations made under it does not apply to premises forming part of an occupied regulated building or a relevant HMO to the extent that the condition in subsection (2) is met in relation to the provision.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The condition is that the provision relates to any matters in relation to which requirements were or could have been imposed in relation to the premises by or under the Fire Safety Order as that order had effect immediately before the relevant time (whether or not the premises existed immediately before the relevant time).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this section—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>the Fire Safety Order</Term>” means the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1541" id="c00055" Year="2005" Number="1541" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument">S.I. 2005/1541</Citation>);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>occupied</Term>” has the meaning given by section 136(1) of the Building Safety (Wales) Act 2026;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>regulated building</Term>” has the meaning given by sections 2 and 7 of that Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>relevant HMO</Term>” has the meaning given by section 78 of that Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the relevant time means the time when paragraph 10 of Schedule 3 to that Act came into force (partial disapplication of the Fire Safety Order in relation to occupied regulated buildings and relevant HMOs).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> shall be amended –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by substituting for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (3) of regulation 4 the following sub-paragraphs –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it is appropriate for the risk or risks involved, the conditions at the place where exposure to such risk or risks may occur, and the period for which it is worn;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it takes account of ergonomic requirements and the state of health of the person or persons who may wear it, and of the characteristics of the workstation of each such person;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it is necessary to ensure that personal protective equipment is hygienic and otherwise free of risk to health, every employer and every self-employed person shall ensure that personal protective equipment provided is provided to a person for use only by him.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c" id="regulation-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 6 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i" id="regulation-5-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii" id="regulation-5-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a semi-colon for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c) and after that by adding the word “and”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii" id="regulation-5-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the following sub-paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an assessment as to whether the personal protective equipment is compatible with other personal protective equipment which is in use and which an employee would be required to wear simultaneously.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d" id="regulation-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) of regulation 9 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i" id="regulation-5-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a comma for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii" id="regulation-5-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the words “and shall ensure that such information is kept available to employees.”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e" id="regulation-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by adding after paragraph (2) of regulation 9 the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1) the employer shall, where appropriate, and at suitable intervals, organise demonstrations in the wearing of personal protective equipment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423" NumberOfProvisions="24" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/body" NumberOfProvisions="15" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> shall be amended –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1), by inserting, before the definition of “new workplace”, the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“disabled person” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Disability Discrimination Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b" id="regulation-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “workplace” in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b/i" id="regulation-6-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a full stop for the comma at the end of sub-paragraph (b); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/b/ii" id="regulation-6-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by deleting the words “but shall not” to the end of the definition;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/c" id="regulation-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 4 the following regulation –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Stability and solidity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a workplace is in a building, the building shall have a stability and solidity appropriate to the nature of the use of the workplace.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d" id="regulation-6-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 5(3) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/i" id="regulation-6-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (a);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/ii" id="regulation-6-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a semi colon for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (b) and after that by adding the word “and”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/d/iii" id="regulation-6-d-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding, after sub-paragraph (b), the following sub-paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>equipment and devices intended to prevent or reduce hazards.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/e" id="regulation-6-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by deleting regulation 6(3);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/f" id="regulation-6-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7, by inserting after paragraph (1) the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1) –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a workplace shall be adequately thermally insulated where it is necessary, having regard to the type of work carried out and the physical activity of the persons carrying out the work; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>excessive effects of sunlight on temperature shall be avoided.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/g" id="regulation-6-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 24, by adding, after the words “men and women”, the words “and the facilities are easily accessible, of sufficient capacity and provided with seating”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/h" id="regulation-6-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 25, by substituting for paragraph (3) the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Rest rooms and rest areas shall –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>include suitable arrangements to protect non-smokers from discomfort caused by tobacco smoke; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be equipped with –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an adequate number of tables and adequate seating with backs for the number of persons at work likely to use them at any one time; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>seating which is adequate for the number of disabled persons at work and suitable for them.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/6/i" id="regulation-6-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 25 the following regulation –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Disabled persons</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">25A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where necessary, those parts of the workplace (including in particular doors, passageways, stairs, showers, washbasins, lavatories and workstations) used or occupied directly by disabled persons at work shall be organised to take account of such persons.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196" NumberOfProvisions="29" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/body" NumberOfProvisions="29" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> shall be amended in accordance with the following paragraphs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (1) of regulation 2 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of the definition of “territorial waters”, the word “and” shall be omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there shall be inserted in the appropriate places in the alphabetical order of the definitions the following definitions –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“passenger train” means a train carrying passengers or made available for the carriage of passengers;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“railway” has the meaning assigned to it by section 6 of the Railway Safety Act (Northern Ireland) 2002;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“running line” means any line which is not a siding and is ordinarily used for the passage of trains; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“train” includes a reference to a locomotive; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For paragraph 12 of Part I of Schedule 2 there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Train collisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision of a train with any other train or vehicle, other than a collision to which Part IV relates, which caused, or might have caused, the death of, or major injury to, any person.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For Part IV of Schedule 2, there shall be substituted the following Part –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Part>
<Number>PART IV</Number>
<Title>DANGEROUS OCCURRENCES WHICH ARE REPORTABLE IN RELATION TO RAILWAYS</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents to passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision in which a passenger train collides with another train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a passenger train or any part of such a train leaves the rails otherwise than deliberately as part of normal railway operations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents not involving passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48C</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision between trains, other than one between a passenger train and another train, on a running line where any train sustains damage as a result of the collision, and any such collision in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, on a running line, except a derailment which occurs during shunting operations and does not obstruct any other running line.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48E</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving any kind of train</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48F</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a buffer stop, other than in a siding, where damage is caused to the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48G</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking any cattle or horse, whether or not damage is caused to the train, or striking any other animal if, in consequence, damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) is caused to the train necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48H</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train on a running line striking or being struck by any object which causes damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair or which might have been liable to derail the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48I</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train, other than one on a railway, striking or being struck by a road vehicle.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48J</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a passenger train, or any other train not fitted with continuous self-applying brakes, becoming divided.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48K</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any of the following classes of accident which occurs or is discovered whilst the train is on a running line –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of an axle;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a wheel or tyre, including a tyre loose on its wheel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a rope or the fastenings thereof or of the winding plant or equipment involved in working an incline;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any fire, severe electrical arcing or fusing in or on any part of a passenger train or a train carrying dangerous goods;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of any train other than a passenger train, any severe electrical arcing or fusing, or any fire which was extinguished by a fire-fighting service;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any other failure of any part of a train which is likely to cause an accident to that or any other train or to kill or injure any person.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this paragraph “dangerous goods” has the same meaning as in regulation 2(1) of the Carriage of Dangerous Goods (Classification, Packaging and Labelling) and Use of Transportable Pressure Receptacles Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents and incidents at level crossings</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48L</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a road vehicle or gate at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48M</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train running onto a level crossing when not authorised to do so.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48N</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A failure of the equipment at a level crossing which could endanger users of the road or path crossing the railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving the permanent way and other works on or connected with railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48O</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The failure of a rail in a running line or of a rack rail, which results in –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a complete fracture of the rail through its cross-section; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a piece becoming detached from the rail which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48P</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A buckle of a running line which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48Q</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of an aircraft or a vehicle of any kind landing on, running onto or coming to rest foul of the line, or damaging the line, which causes damage which obstructs the line or which damages any railway equipment at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48R</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The runaway of an escalator, lift or passenger conveyor.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48S</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire or severe arcing or fusing which seriously affects the functioning of signalling equipment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48T</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire affecting the permanent way or works of a railway which necessitates the suspension of services over any line, or the closure of any part of a station or signal box or other premises, for a period –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a fire affecting any part of a railway below ground, of more than 30 minutes, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, of more than 1 hour.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48U</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any other fire which causes damage which has the potential to affect the running of a railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving failure of the works on or connected with a railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48V</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following classes of accident where they are likely either to cause an accident to a train or to endanger any person –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a tunnel, bridge, viaduct, culvert, station, or other structure or any part thereof;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any failure in the signalling system which endangers or which has the potential to endanger the safe passage of trains other than a failure of a traffic light controlling the movement of vehicles on a road;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a slip of a cutting or of an embankment;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>flooding of the permanent way;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the striking of a bridge by a vessel or by a road vehicle or its load; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of any other portion of the permanent way or works not specified above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of serious congestion</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48W</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where planned procedures or arrangements have been activated in order to control risks arising from an incident of undue passenger congestion at a station unless that congestion has been relieved within a period of time allowed for by those procedures or arrangements.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of signals passed without authority</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48X</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a train, travelling on a running line or entering a running line from a siding, passes without authority a signal displaying a stop aspect unless the stop aspect was not displayed in sufficient time for the driver to stop safely at the signal.</Text>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 7, the entries relating to –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Regulation of Railways Act 1871 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1871/78" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1871" Number="0078">1871 c. 78)</Citation> and Orders and Regulations made or to be made thereunder; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Railway Employment (Prevention of Accidents) Act 1900 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1900/27" id="c00002" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1900" Number="0027">1900 c. 27)</Citation>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>shall be omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196" NumberOfProvisions="29" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/body" NumberOfProvisions="29" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> shall be amended in accordance with the following paragraphs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (1) of regulation 2 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of the definition of “territorial waters”, the word “and” shall be omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there shall be inserted in the appropriate places in the alphabetical order of the definitions the following definitions –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“passenger train” means a train carrying passengers or made available for the carriage of passengers;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“railway” has the meaning assigned to it by section 6 of the Railway Safety Act (Northern Ireland) 2002;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“running line” means any line which is not a siding and is ordinarily used for the passage of trains; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“train” includes a reference to a locomotive; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For paragraph 12 of Part I of Schedule 2 there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Train collisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision of a train with any other train or vehicle, other than a collision to which Part IV relates, which caused, or might have caused, the death of, or major injury to, any person.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For Part IV of Schedule 2, there shall be substituted the following Part –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Part>
<Number>PART IV</Number>
<Title>DANGEROUS OCCURRENCES WHICH ARE REPORTABLE IN RELATION TO RAILWAYS</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents to passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision in which a passenger train collides with another train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a passenger train or any part of such a train leaves the rails otherwise than deliberately as part of normal railway operations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents not involving passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48C</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision between trains, other than one between a passenger train and another train, on a running line where any train sustains damage as a result of the collision, and any such collision in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, on a running line, except a derailment which occurs during shunting operations and does not obstruct any other running line.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48E</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving any kind of train</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48F</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a buffer stop, other than in a siding, where damage is caused to the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48G</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking any cattle or horse, whether or not damage is caused to the train, or striking any other animal if, in consequence, damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) is caused to the train necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48H</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train on a running line striking or being struck by any object which causes damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair or which might have been liable to derail the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48I</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train, other than one on a railway, striking or being struck by a road vehicle.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48J</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a passenger train, or any other train not fitted with continuous self-applying brakes, becoming divided.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48K</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any of the following classes of accident which occurs or is discovered whilst the train is on a running line –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of an axle;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a wheel or tyre, including a tyre loose on its wheel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a rope or the fastenings thereof or of the winding plant or equipment involved in working an incline;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any fire, severe electrical arcing or fusing in or on any part of a passenger train or a train carrying dangerous goods;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of any train other than a passenger train, any severe electrical arcing or fusing, or any fire which was extinguished by a fire-fighting service;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any other failure of any part of a train which is likely to cause an accident to that or any other train or to kill or injure any person.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this paragraph “dangerous goods” has the same meaning as in regulation 2(1) of the Carriage of Dangerous Goods (Classification, Packaging and Labelling) and Use of Transportable Pressure Receptacles Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents and incidents at level crossings</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48L</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a road vehicle or gate at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48M</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train running onto a level crossing when not authorised to do so.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48N</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A failure of the equipment at a level crossing which could endanger users of the road or path crossing the railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving the permanent way and other works on or connected with railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48O</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The failure of a rail in a running line or of a rack rail, which results in –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a complete fracture of the rail through its cross-section; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a piece becoming detached from the rail which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48P</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A buckle of a running line which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48Q</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of an aircraft or a vehicle of any kind landing on, running onto or coming to rest foul of the line, or damaging the line, which causes damage which obstructs the line or which damages any railway equipment at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48R</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The runaway of an escalator, lift or passenger conveyor.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48S</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire or severe arcing or fusing which seriously affects the functioning of signalling equipment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48T</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire affecting the permanent way or works of a railway which necessitates the suspension of services over any line, or the closure of any part of a station or signal box or other premises, for a period –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a fire affecting any part of a railway below ground, of more than 30 minutes, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, of more than 1 hour.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48U</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any other fire which causes damage which has the potential to affect the running of a railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving failure of the works on or connected with a railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48V</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following classes of accident where they are likely either to cause an accident to a train or to endanger any person –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a tunnel, bridge, viaduct, culvert, station, or other structure or any part thereof;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any failure in the signalling system which endangers or which has the potential to endanger the safe passage of trains other than a failure of a traffic light controlling the movement of vehicles on a road;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a slip of a cutting or of an embankment;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>flooding of the permanent way;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the striking of a bridge by a vessel or by a road vehicle or its load; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of any other portion of the permanent way or works not specified above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of serious congestion</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48W</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where planned procedures or arrangements have been activated in order to control risks arising from an incident of undue passenger congestion at a station unless that congestion has been relieved within a period of time allowed for by those procedures or arrangements.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of signals passed without authority</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48X</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a train, travelling on a running line or entering a running line from a siding, passes without authority a signal displaying a stop aspect unless the stop aspect was not displayed in sufficient time for the driver to stop safely at the signal.</Text>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 7, the entries relating to –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Regulation of Railways Act 1871 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1871/78" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1871" Number="0078">1871 c. 78)</Citation> and Orders and Regulations made or to be made thereunder; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Railway Employment (Prevention of Accidents) Act 1900 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1900/27" id="c00002" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1900" Number="0027">1900 c. 27)</Citation>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>shall be omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196" NumberOfProvisions="29" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/body" NumberOfProvisions="29" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> shall be amended in accordance with the following paragraphs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (1) of regulation 2 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of the definition of “territorial waters”, the word “and” shall be omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there shall be inserted in the appropriate places in the alphabetical order of the definitions the following definitions –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“passenger train” means a train carrying passengers or made available for the carriage of passengers;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“railway” has the meaning assigned to it by section 6 of the Railway Safety Act (Northern Ireland) 2002;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“running line” means any line which is not a siding and is ordinarily used for the passage of trains; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“train” includes a reference to a locomotive; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For paragraph 12 of Part I of Schedule 2 there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Train collisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision of a train with any other train or vehicle, other than a collision to which Part IV relates, which caused, or might have caused, the death of, or major injury to, any person.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/196/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For Part IV of Schedule 2, there shall be substituted the following Part –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Part>
<Number>PART IV</Number>
<Title>DANGEROUS OCCURRENCES WHICH ARE REPORTABLE IN RELATION TO RAILWAYS</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents to passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision in which a passenger train collides with another train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a passenger train or any part of such a train leaves the rails otherwise than deliberately as part of normal railway operations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents not involving passenger trains</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48C</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any collision between trains, other than one between a passenger train and another train, on a running line where any train sustains damage as a result of the collision, and any such collision in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, on a running line, except a derailment which occurs during shunting operations and does not obstruct any other running line.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48E</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any derailment, of a train other than a passenger train, in a siding which results in a running line being obstructed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving any kind of train</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48F</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a buffer stop, other than in a siding, where damage is caused to the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48G</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking any cattle or horse, whether or not damage is caused to the train, or striking any other animal if, in consequence, damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) is caused to the train necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48H</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train on a running line striking or being struck by any object which causes damage (including damage to the windows of the driver’s cab but excluding other damage consisting solely in the breakage of glass) necessitating immediate temporary or permanent repair or which might have been liable to derail the train.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48I</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train, other than one on a railway, striking or being struck by a road vehicle.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48J</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a passenger train, or any other train not fitted with continuous self-applying brakes, becoming divided.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48K</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any of the following classes of accident which occurs or is discovered whilst the train is on a running line –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of an axle;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a wheel or tyre, including a tyre loose on its wheel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a rope or the fastenings thereof or of the winding plant or equipment involved in working an incline;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any fire, severe electrical arcing or fusing in or on any part of a passenger train or a train carrying dangerous goods;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of any train other than a passenger train, any severe electrical arcing or fusing, or any fire which was extinguished by a fire-fighting service;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any other failure of any part of a train which is likely to cause an accident to that or any other train or to kill or injure any person.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this paragraph “dangerous goods” has the same meaning as in regulation 2(1) of the Carriage of Dangerous Goods (Classification, Packaging and Labelling) and Use of Transportable Pressure Receptacles Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents and incidents at level crossings</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48L</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train striking a road vehicle or gate at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48M</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of a train running onto a level crossing when not authorised to do so.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48N</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A failure of the equipment at a level crossing which could endanger users of the road or path crossing the railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving the permanent way and other works on or connected with railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48O</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The failure of a rail in a running line or of a rack rail, which results in –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a complete fracture of the rail through its cross-section; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a piece becoming detached from the rail which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48P</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A buckle of a running line which necessitates an immediate stoppage of traffic or the immediate imposition of a speed restriction lower than that currently in force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48Q</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case of an aircraft or a vehicle of any kind landing on, running onto or coming to rest foul of the line, or damaging the line, which causes damage which obstructs the line or which damages any railway equipment at a level crossing.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48R</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The runaway of an escalator, lift or passenger conveyor.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48S</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire or severe arcing or fusing which seriously affects the functioning of signalling equipment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48T</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any fire affecting the permanent way or works of a railway which necessitates the suspension of services over any line, or the closure of any part of a station or signal box or other premises, for a period –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a fire affecting any part of a railway below ground, of more than 30 minutes, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, of more than 1 hour.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48U</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any other fire which causes damage which has the potential to affect the running of a railway.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Accidents involving failure of the works on or connected with a railway</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48V</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following classes of accident where they are likely either to cause an accident to a train or to endanger any person –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of a tunnel, bridge, viaduct, culvert, station, or other structure or any part thereof;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any failure in the signalling system which endangers or which has the potential to endanger the safe passage of trains other than a failure of a traffic light controlling the movement of vehicles on a road;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a slip of a cutting or of an embankment;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>flooding of the permanent way;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the striking of a bridge by a vessel or by a road vehicle or its load; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the failure of any other portion of the permanent way or works not specified above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of serious congestion</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48W</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where planned procedures or arrangements have been activated in order to control risks arising from an incident of undue passenger congestion at a station unless that congestion has been relieved within a period of time allowed for by those procedures or arrangements.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Incidents of signals passed without authority</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>48X</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any case where a train, travelling on a running line or entering a running line from a siding, passes without authority a signal displaying a stop aspect unless the stop aspect was not displayed in sufficient time for the driver to stop safely at the signal.</Text>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 7, the entries relating to –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Regulation of Railways Act 1871 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1871/78" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1871" Number="0078">1871 c. 78)</Citation> and Orders and Regulations made or to be made thereunder; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Railway Employment (Prevention of Accidents) Act 1900 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1900/27" id="c00002" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1900" Number="0027">1900 c. 27)</Citation>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>shall be omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165" NumberOfProvisions="12" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “maximum exposure limit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
