RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “maximum exposure limit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “maximum exposure limit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">

</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">

<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>

<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>

<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>

<Text>in paragraph 7 of part I of Schedule 1 for the words “regulation 5(1)(d) of the Diving Operations at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1994 and used or intended to be used in the course of a diving project” there shall be substituted the words “regulation 6(3)(b) of the Diving at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 4 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/i" id="schedule-3-paragraph-6-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 1(1) of the definition of “activity” for the words “diving operation” there shall be substituted the words “diving project”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/ii" id="schedule-3-paragraph-6-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the definition “diving operation” there shall be substituted the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“diving project” has the same meaning assigned to it by regulation 2(1) of the Diving at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005 save that it includes an activity in which a person takes part as a diver wearing an atmospheric pressure suit and without breathing in air or other gas at a pressure greater than atmospheric pressure;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/45/schedule/3/paragraph/6/b/iii" id="schedule-3-paragraph-6-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 2(1)(c) and in head (f) of the definition of “pipeline works” in paragraph 4(2) and in paragraph 6(d) for the words “diving operation” there shall be substituted the words “diving project”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph 6(1)(a), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any unintentional fire, explosion or ignition at a site—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>

<P5para>

<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P5para>

</P5para>

<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P5para>

</P3para>

<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“danger zone” means the area from which persons have been excluded or forbidden to enter to avoid being endangered by any explosion or ignition of explosives; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“explosives” has the same meaning as in the Manufacture and Storage of Explosives Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/3" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 7 (statutory provisions requiring the notification of events which are not required to be notified or reported under the Regulations), omit the entry relating to the Explosives Act 1875.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>

</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit sub-paragraph (d) and the word “or” preceding it; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (6), omit sub-paragraphs (a) and (b).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 14 (Duties of persons at work) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Special provision in relation to caving and climbing</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">14A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>Paragraph (2) applies in relation to the application of these Regulations to work concerning the provision of instruction or leadership to one or more persons in connection with their engagement in caving or climbing by way of sport, recreation, team building or similar activities.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where this paragraph applies, an employer, self-employed person or other person shall be taken to have complied with the caving and climbing requirements, if, by alternative means to any requirement of those requirements, he maintains in relation to a person at such work as is referred to in paragraph (1) a level of safety equivalent to that required by those requirements.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of paragraph (2), in determining whether an equivalent level of safety is maintained, regard shall be had to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the nature of the activity;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any publicly available and generally accepted procedures for the activity; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any other relevant circumstances.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this regulation—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“caving” includes the exploration of parts of mines which are no longer worked;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“climbing” means climbing, traversing, abseiling or scrambling over natural terrain or man-made structures; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the caving and climbing requirements” means regulation 8(d)(ii), so far as it relates to paragraph 1 in Part 3 of Schedule 6, and that paragraph.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph 1 of Part 3 of Schedule 6—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4/a" id="regulation-2-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the beginning, insert “Except as provided in paragraph 3,”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/4/b" id="regulation-2-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a), omit “subject to paragraph 3.”</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
Amendment of Regulations 2 The Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2010 are amended in accordance with regulations 3 to 10. Interpretation – General 3 1 In regulation 2, the Table in paragraph (5) is amended as follows. 2 For the row containing the expression and meaning of “conformity mark”, substitute—
“conformity mark”The mark referred to in article 14 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive, the form of the mark being set out in article 15 of that Directive.
3 Before the row in which the expression “conformity mark” is given a meaning, insert—
“conformity assessment”The assessment and the procedure for assessment of conformity set out in the Directives.
4 After the row in which the expression “the Dangerous Goods Directive” is given a meaning, insert—
“the Directives”The Dangerous Goods Directive and the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive.
5 After the row in which the expression “national carriage” is given a meaning, insert—
“relevant member State”A member State of the EU on whose market the equipment in question has been made available.
6 After the row in which the expression “the security provisions” is given a meaning, insert—
“TPED competent authority”The GB competent authority or the competent national authority in respect of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive in Northern Ireland or another member State of the EU.
7 For the row containing the expression and meaning of “the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive” substitute—
“the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive”Directive 2010/35/EU of the European Parliament and the Council of 16 June 2010 on transportable pressure equipment and repealing Council Directives 76/767/EEC, 84/525/EEC, 84/526/EEC, 84/527/EEC and 1999/36/EC.
Interpretation of <Acronym Expansion="Accord European Relatif au Transports International des Merchandises Dangereuses par Route" xml:lang="fr">ADR</Acronym>, <Acronym Expansion="Regulations Concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Rail">RID</Acronym> and ADN 4 1 Regulation 3 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraphs (b) and (c), for “Communities” substitute “EU”. 3 Omit paragraphs (f), (g), and (h). 4 In paragraph (k), at the end, omit “and”. 5 In paragraph (l), at the end, for “.” substitute— ; m Sub-sections 2.2.1.1.2, 2.2.1.1.3 and 2.2.1.1.4 of ADR apply as if the words “by the competent authority of a Contracting Party” were included after the word “assigned”; and n Sub-sections 2.2.1.1.2, 2.2.1.1.3 and 2.2.1.1.4 of RID apply as if the words “by the competent authority of a Member State of COTIF” were included after the word “assigned”. . Obligations relating to the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive 5 1 For regulation 15, substitute— Scope of Obligations 15 1 Regulations 15A to 15F apply to transportable pressure equipment within the scope of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive by virtue of article 1(2)(a) of that Directive. 2 For the avoidance of doubt, any reference in those regulations to a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator as “it” is not to be construed as excluding a natural person. . 2 After regulation 15, insert— General Obligations 15A 1 A manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator may only place or make available on the market, put into service or use equipment if it ensures that the equipment meets the requirements of the Dangerous Goods Directive. 2 On receipt of a request from the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator must identify to the Executive any manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner who has supplied it with, or to whom it has supplied, equipment over at least the previous 10 years. 3 A request made pursuant to paragraph (2) must— a be in writing; and b contain a date by which a response is to be provided with that date being reasonable in all the circumstances. 4 Paragraph (5) applies where a manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner provides to an operator information about equipment it has placed or made available on the market, or put into service. 5 The information must comply with the Directives. 6 This regulation does not apply to an owner who is a private individual using or intending to use equipment in the circumstances set out in article 8(4) of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive. Obligations of Manufacturers 15B 1 A manufacturer must— a ensure a conformity assessment is carried out by a notified body; b mark equipment in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; and c keep the technical documentation specified in the Dangerous Goods Directive for the period specified in that Directive. 2 Where a manufacturer knows or has reason to believe that equipment it has placed on the market does not comply with the Directives, that manufacturer must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives, b withdraw the equipment from the market, or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where a manufacturer considers that equipment it has placed on the market presents a risk, that manufacturer must immediately inform the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State of the risk, including providing details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 4 A manufacturer must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 5 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, a manufacturer must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action it takes to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. 6 This regulation applies to an importer or a distributor as if that person were a manufacturer where the importer or distributor— a places equipment on the market under the importer or distributor’s own name or trademark; or b modifies equipment already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the Directives may be affected. Obligations of Importers 15C 1 An importer must ensure that— a the manufacturer has complied with conformity assessment and drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with the Dangerous Goods Directive; b equipment has been marked in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; c the certificate of conformity for the equipment either contains the name and address of the importer or has this information attached to it; d the conditions in which equipment under the responsibility of the importer is stored and transported do not jeopardise the equipment’s compliance with the Dangerous Goods Directive; and e the technical documentation specified in the Dangerous Goods Directive is kept for the period set out in that Directive. 2 Where an importer knows or has reason to believe that equipment it has placed on the market does not comply with the Directives, that importer must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives; b withdraw the equipment from the market; or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where an importer considers that equipment presents a risk before it has been placed on the market, that importer must inform the manufacturer and the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland of the risk. 4 Where an importer considers that equipment it has placed on the market presents a risk, that importer must immediately inform the manufacturer and the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State of the risk, including details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 5 An importer must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 6 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, an importer must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action taken to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. Obligations of Distributors 15D 1 A distributor must ensure that— a the equipment has been marked in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; b the certificate of conformity for the equipment contains or has attached to it the name and address of the importer where relevant; and c the conditions in which equipment under the responsibility of the distributor is stored and transported do not jeopardise the equipment’s compliance with the Directives. 2 Where a distributor knows or has reason to believe that equipment it made available on the market does not comply with the Directives, that distributor must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives; b withdraw the equipment from the market; or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where a distributor considers that equipment presents a risk before it has been made available on the market, that distributor must inform— a the manufacturer or the importer; and b the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, of the risk. 4 Where a distributor considers that equipment it has made available on the market presents a risk, that distributor must immediately inform— a the manufacturer or the importer; and b the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State, of the risk, including details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 5 A distributor must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measures taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 6 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, a distributor must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action taken to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. Obligations relating to the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive 5 1 For regulation 15, substitute— Scope of Obligations 15 1 Regulations 15A to 15F apply to transportable pressure equipment within the scope of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive by virtue of article 1(2)(a) of that Directive. 2 For the avoidance of doubt, any reference in those regulations to a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator as “it” is not to be construed as excluding a natural person. . 2 After regulation 15, insert— General Obligations 15A 1 A manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator may only place or make available on the market, put into service or use equipment if it ensures that the equipment meets the requirements of the Dangerous Goods Directive. 2 On receipt of a request from the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator must identify to the Executive any manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner who has supplied it with, or to whom it has supplied, equipment over at least the previous 10 years. 3 A request made pursuant to paragraph (2) must— a be in writing; and b contain a date by which a response is to be provided with that date being reasonable in all the circumstances. 4 Paragraph (5) applies where a manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner provides to an operator information about equipment it has placed or made available on the market, or put into service. 5 The information must comply with the Directives. 6 This regulation does not apply to an owner who is a private individual using or intending to use equipment in the circumstances set out in article 8(4) of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive. Obligations of Manufacturers 15B 1 A manufacturer must— a ensure a conformity assessment is carried out by a notified body; b mark equipment in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; and c keep the technical documentation specified in the Dangerous Goods Directive for the period specified in that Directive. 2 Where a manufacturer knows or has reason to believe that equipment it has placed on the market does not comply with the Directives, that manufacturer must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives, b withdraw the equipment from the market, or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where a manufacturer considers that equipment it has placed on the market presents a risk, that manufacturer must immediately inform the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State of the risk, including providing details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 4 A manufacturer must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 5 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, a manufacturer must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action it takes to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. 6 This regulation applies to an importer or a distributor as if that person were a manufacturer where the importer or distributor— a places equipment on the market under the importer or distributor’s own name or trademark; or b modifies equipment already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the Directives may be affected.
